svg.title: The plan folder
svg.desc: The plan folder Masterplan writes: README.md (start here), STATUS.md (live progress), IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md (milestone goals and briefed steps), SKILLS_USAGE.md (which skill to use for each step), planning/ (intent, ranked options, sources, decisions), and one folder per milestone with its own README.md, STATUS.md and one file per step.
